title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Add a suite of RAG-focused developer docs: quickstarts for creating retrieval-augmented agents, several tool-calling examples (calendar, enterprise-search, and safe-exec), and corresponding docs-site/nav updates. Motivation: Make it easier for engineers to adopt RAG patterns and tool-calling workflows with Redwood by providing copy-paste-ready templates and end-to-end examples that reflect current RTS best practices. What changed: 1) docs/quickstarts/rag-agent-templates.md - new templates (vectorstore-backed RAG agent, streaming answer mode, partial-retry fallback) 2) docs/examples/tool-calling/calendar-example.md - shows tool registration, auth patterns, and a calendar tool integration for scheduling flows 3) docs/examples/tool-calling/search-and-qa.md - enterprise-search + reranker example with prompt templates and eval notes 4) docs/examples/tool-calling/safe-exec.md - sandboxed tool-execution pattern and recommended RBAC guardrails 5) docs/snippets/ - added quick copyable SDK snippets for Python/TS/Go 6) docs-site: sidebar and quickstart index updated so examples are discoverable 7) redwood-examples repo reference added to docs to point to runnable samples (link to redwood-examples repo). Checklist: - [x] Quickstarts drafted and reviewed - [x] Examples run against local dev environment and redwood-local - [x] Docs build and linkcheck passing after fixes - [x] Cross-language snippets validated (Python/TS/Go) Testing: Ran docs build (mkdocs), linkcheck, and example harness against local redwood stack; manual smoke tests for calendar tool (create/list/delete) and search QA with small vector index were performed. CI: initial docs/linkcheck failed on a moved anchor; fixed and re-ran. Follow-ups: (a) Add a runnable demo workflow to redwood-examples repo (ENG-6713), (b) Add automated end-to-end CI tests for examples (ENG-6720). Release notes: Adds RAG agent quickstarts and three tool-calling examples to developer docs; no breaking changes.
commits: Initial draft of RAG quickstarts and templates
Add calendar and search tool-calling examples with SDK snippets
Docs-site sidebar/nav updates and cross-linking to redwood-examples
Fix linkcheck failures and update examples after reviewer feedback
Address lint and formatting issues for snippets
